stories.title: Ukraine drones hit Kerch bridge linking Russia and Crimea
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck the Kerch Strait bridge overnight, with the Kremlin calling the damage minor and traffic temporarily restricted. The strike came amid what Russia called Ukraine's largest drone attack of the war.

stories.title: Regulators warn nuclear accident risk in Ukraine is rising this winter
stories.summary: Nuclear safety regulators from 38 countries warned that Russian attacks on Ukraine's power grid are raising the risk of a nuclear accident this winter and urged Moscow to stop. A nationwide blackout could affect all nine operating reactors at once, they said.

stories.title: Trump to raise Ukraine war in Xi-Putin meeting; may meet Kim Jong Un
stories.summary: President Trump said he plans to discuss Russia's war in Ukraine during this week's trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, and that he may meet Kim Jong Un while in China.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes oil depot in Russia's Rostov Oblast, General Staff confirms
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck an oil depot in Russia's Rostov Oblast, setting it ablaze, Ukraine's General Staff confirmed. The attack was part of a wider overnight drone campaign.

stories.title: OpenAI to embed Apollo researchers to investigate AI subversion
stories.summary: OpenAI will embed researchers from Apollo to investigate AI subversion, deepening its work on safety risks from models that could undermine human oversight. The move follows growing focus on AI safety at the lab.

stories.title: OpenAI releases image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
stories.summary: OpenAI shipped a new image classifier and added ChatGPT warnings aimed at combating child sexual abuse material. The tools are the company's latest step in content safety.

stories.title: Nvidia board won't consider reinstating Jensen Huang despite petition
stories.summary: Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO despite an online petition that has drawn more than 180,000 signatures. Huang resigned last week amid reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

stories.title: US tightens AI chip export controls to curb China's remote access
stories.summary: The US issued new rules restricting remote access to advanced AI chips and servers, the latest step to limit China's ability to use American computing power. The change follows the Nvidia espionage scandal.

stories.title: Harold Fannin Jr.'s breakout continues as Browns head to bye
stories.summary: Rookie tight end Harold Fannin Jr. has caught 25 passes for 378 yards over his last four games, averaging 94.5 yards per contest over the past month. Cleveland enters its bye week at 6-4 after beating Houston.

stories.title: Browns are 6-4 behind comebacks, yet fans haven't fallen in love
stories.summary: Cleveland is 6-4 behind a string of thrilling comebacks, but the fanbase hasn't fully embraced the team. Deshaun Watson threw the decisive fourth-quarter touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston.

stories.title: Browns' comeback win over Texans fuels playoff talk
stories.summary: The Browns pulled off another Houdini act, rallying from 17 points down to beat the Texans 27-24, and the win has Cleveland thinking about the postseason. Cleveland heads into the bye at 6-4.

stories.title: Browns beat Texans 27-24, rally from 17 down to move to 6-4
stories.summary: Cleveland erased a 17-point deficit to beat Houston 27-24, already surpassing its preseason over/under win total of 5.5. The Browns stayed undefeated at home and head into the bye week.

stories.title: Ohio State jumps five spots to No. 16 in latest AP Poll
stories.summary: The Buckeyes climbed five spots to No. 16 in the AP Poll after their 28-19 win over Northwestern. Ohio State owns road wins over No. 6 Indiana and No. 13 Iowa but remains on the CFP bubble.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith named Biletnikoff Award semifinalist for third straight season
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith is a Biletnikoff Award semifinalist for a third consecutive season. He leads the Buckeyes with 80 catches, 1,317 receiving yards and 15 touchdowns.

stories.title: Ohio State still in hunt for Big Ten title and CFP spot, odds say
stories.summary: Despite a two-game losing streak, the 7-3 Buckeyes remain in contention for the Big Ten championship game and a College Football Playoff spot. Ohio State visits Nebraska on Nov. 21.

stories.title: Ohio State hard-launches 'JJ 4 It All' Heisman push for Jeremiah Smith
stories.summary: The Buckeyes officially launched their JJ 4 It All campaign for Jeremiah Smith's Heisman bid after his record-setting game against Northwestern. Ryan Day said the program has an obligation to this young man.

stories.title: Hamilton drops to 22nd in sports marketability ranking as Leclerc leads F1
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton fell from first to 22nd in SportsPro's ranking of the world's 50 most marketable athletes, with Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc now the top-ranked F1 driver in second.

stories.title: Antonelli expected to earn less than Russell despite 2026 title
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli is expected to earn less than Mercedes teammate George Russell next season despite winning the 2026 title as F1's youngest-ever world champion at 20. His bonuses are estimated at 10-12 million euros.

stories.title: Haas confirms Rafael Camara will race at Las Vegas Grand Prix
stories.summary: Haas confirmed Rafael Camara will race at this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, his second F1 start after debuting in Brazil. Ryo Hirakawa will take Oliver Bearman's car for FP1.

stories.title: Five storylines to watch as F1 heads to Las Vegas
stories.summary: With both championships decided, focus shifts to the fight for third in the constructors' standings, where Red Bull leads McLaren by 17 points. Racing Bulls confirmed Lawson and Lindblad will continue into 2027.

stories.title: Tarkov City Twitch Drops campaign launches with unique PMC shirts
stories.summary: Battlestate Games launched the Tarkov City Twitch Drops campaign, rewarding viewers with in-game containers and two unique PMC shirts. The campaign runs through Nov. 23.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov announces Tarkov City Drops Campaign
stories.summary: Battlestate Games announced the Tarkov City Twitch Drops campaign, headlined by two unique shirts for your PMC, as a way to bring resort vibes to Tarkov.

stories.title: Gahanna City Council takes up 2027 budget and utility rate hikes
stories.summary: Gahanna City Council meets Monday night for a public hearing on the fiscal 2027 budget and an ordinance setting new utility rates and fees starting Jan. 1, 2027. Council will also weigh a $365,000 self-insurance fund appropriation.
